title: Switchyard / Frugal Heart
objective: Resume Switchyard as a deterministic capability/tier resolver that chooses the cheapest currently qualified legal route without changing authority, legality or execution state.

evidence: V2-010M/S/Q current metabolism, experience and artifact reuse
great_harvest_preflight.reason: Current and harvested stock already define request constraints, local-first posture, provider health and certification separation; resume the smallest deterministic resolver rather than inventing a new router.

pandaos_reconstruction.rule: Panda-like model-choice clarity may explain selected/rejected routes; Panda does not own provider state, routing authority or execution.

laws: Switchyard filters only predeclared legal candidates and never invents capability or legality.
Provider healthy is not builder certified; engineering selection requires explicit task-capable certification.
UNTESTED, unavailable, privacy-incompatible or over-budget candidates cannot win by fallback guesswork.
Within the legal qualified set, choose the cheapest capable candidate; locality and measured task trust are deterministic tie-breakers only.
Remote escalation remains gated and cannot bypass LOCAL_ONLY or LOCAL_REQUIRED constraints.
Model/provider choice grants no execution, admission, approval or promotion authority.
